name: auth
title: Auth
description: Cookie-session authentication for Cirrus — email/password sign-up/sign-in on top of @cirrus/auth (a thin wrapper over better-auth), with the auth instance and request handler wired into your project.
docs: Mount handleAuthRequest in your Worker entry (see the README), set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (a 32+ char secret — `openssl rand -base64 32`) and BETTER_AUTH_URL, then apply better-auth's schema to your D1 database. In dev, ensureMigrated(auth) auto-applies it; in production prefer compileMigrationsSql(auth.options) piped to `wrangler d1 execute`.

envVars.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
envVars.description: Encryption secret for better-auth sessions (min 32 chars). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

envVars.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of your app, used by better-auth for callbacks and cookies.
